info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_File Payment Consent Management API
info.description: The File Payment Consent Management API facilitates the submission of file payment consents in an open banking context. This API allows financial institutions and third-party providers to create and manage file payment consents efficiently. By using this endpoint, authorized users can initiate file-based payments on behalf of their clients, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. Typical consumers include banks, payment service providers, and fintech applications that require integration with open banking practices.

post.summary: Create a file payment consent for a specific resource.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a file payment consent associated with a specific resource ID. It is designed for Payment Initiation Service Providers (PISPs) to manage consents efficiently and facilitate secure payment operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a file payment consent process for the specified resource. It should contain all necessary data in JSON format that defines the payment consent being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the file has been processed.
